# App Store Data API

> Read-only, normalized public-data reads of App Store applications exposed through the ReplyNodes fetcher domain: app lookup, bounded term search, and related-app listings. GET-only read capabilities with Bearer workspace-key or x402 v2 negotiation
> at the gateway, bounded pages, normalized v1 payloads, and
> transparent errors plus an explicit unsupported-capability matrix.

Base URL: deployment-specific. The supported public gateway base URL is https://api.replynodes.com. Use this deployment base unless your workspace is explicitly issued another HTTPS gateway URL; never use localhost:18789.

## Surface status

- The three supported read operations are implemented and behavior-tested today in services/appstore-fetcher (issue #15): capability gating before any egress, explicit egress allowlisting including redirects, bounded timeouts and response sizes, and strict normalization into the v1 contract.
- Route paths in this catalog are stable capability identifiers used for agent tool bindings; public gateway exposure for this platform is issued to your workspace at onboarding and must not be assumed reachable anywhere else.
- No availability, uptime, latency, or success-rate figure is claimed anywhere in this package; example payloads are illustrative fixtures, not captured responses.

## Endpoints

- `GET /v1/appstore/app` - Look up one public App Store application (capability `app`; requires a ReplyNodes API key at the gateway).
  - Query parameter `id` (optional): Numeric track id (up to 19 digits) or reverse-DNS-style bundle id; provide id or appId.
  - Query parameter `appId` (optional): Alias for id; provide appId or id.
  - Query parameter `country` (optional): Optional storefront hint, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase (e.g. us).
  - Query parameter `language` (optional): Optional language hint, ISO 639-1 lowercase optionally followed by -<region> (e.g. en or en-us).
- `GET /v1/appstore/search` - Search public App Store applications by term (capability `search`; requires a ReplyNodes API key at the gateway).
  - Query parameter `term` (required): Free-text search query; required and never empty after trimming.
  - Query parameter `limit` (optional): Page size bound; defaults to 20 and is clamped to at most 50 client-side.
  - Query parameter `country` (optional): Optional storefront hint, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase (e.g. us).
  - Query parameter `language` (optional): Optional language hint, ISO 639-1 lowercase optionally followed by -<region> (e.g. en or en-us).
- `GET /v1/appstore/similar` - List public apps related to one App Store application (capability `similar`; requires a ReplyNodes API key at the gateway).
  - Query parameter `id` (optional): Numeric track id (up to 19 digits) or reverse-DNS-style bundle id; provide id or appId.
  - Query parameter `appId` (optional): Alias for id; provide appId or id.
  - Query parameter `country` (optional): Optional storefront hint, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lowercase (e.g. us).
  - Query parameter `language` (optional): Optional language hint, ISO 639-1 lowercase optionally followed by -<region> (e.g. en or en-us).

## Essentials

- Auth: use `Authorization: Bearer *** API key>` or follow x402 v2 payment requirements returned as HTTP 402; scope and entitlement enforcement belong to the shared control plane.
- Envelope: success `{data:[app records], meta{request_id, contract_version, generated_at, availability}}`; failure `{error:{code, message, request_id}}`.
- Correlation: supply an opaque request id per call; it is echoed as `meta.request_id`.
- Page bounds: Search returns one bounded page: limit defaults to 20 when omitted and is clamped client-side to at most 50 regardless of what a caller requests. There are no continuation tokens on this surface.
- Honesty rules: counters/scores/prices are `null` when the source omits them (zeros are never fabricated); `meta.availability` reports completeness; unknown upstream fields are dropped.
- Guarantees: GET-only public data; no purchase/review/account capability exists now or later; the read layer carries no credential material of any kind.

## Error codes

- `400 invalid_request`
- `404 not_found`
- `429 rate_limited`
- `502 upstream_unavailable`
- `503 degraded`

## Unsupported capabilities (do not improvise)

- `list` (deferred scope)
- `developer` (deferred scope)
- `reviews` (deferred scope)
- `ratings` (deferred scope)
- `suggest` (deferred scope)
- `*write_or_authenticated` (read only policy)
